description: You know what, I honestly don't know what I was thinking here. This is one of those "throw things at the wall and see if it works" kinds of pieces. It would have been completely uninteresting were it not for the Uilleann Pipes. Not a lot of music out there for bagpipes and electric piano. Consider the void filled!
instruments: Bass, Drums, Guitar, Electric Piano, Uilleann Pipes
title: Cold Sober
